notes: Custom Finnish shop platform (SumUp-hosted 'os-theme' storefront), server-rendered, requests+BS4 works cleanly. Only 8 products, 1 page — a <link rel="next" href="...?page=2"> is present in the <head> but ?page=2 returns zero products, so treat pagination as none. product_url has no separate selector needed: the product_container itself IS the <a> tag, its href attribute is the product link (absolute URL). in_stock is INVERTED — presence of .product-sold-out-label (text 'Loppuunmyyty') inside the container means OUT OF STOCK; absence means in stock. Confirmed working on both in-stock and sold-out products (6 of 8 products were sold out at time of check).
